_comment: Baseline not yet measured. `ctadl index` on this app had not finished after two hours (2.9 GB resident, one core pegged); a bare index with no model is just as slow, so the cost is the app, not the model. The empty baseline is the safe placeholder: this app declares no isNegative findings, so it cannot fail on a false positive, and an empty matched list cannot regress. Whatever ctadl detects is reported as an improvement -- run the suite with `--filter remote_control_smack`, give it the time, and commit the IDs it prints. See ../../README.md.
